title: Cut and project schemes in the Poincaré disc: From cocompact Fuchsian groups to chaotic Delone sets
summary: A question raised by Davies et al [Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 2023] is: "Can developing new cut and project models, where the lattice is not square or the curve is non-linear, generate better performing graded metamaterials?" In this article, we study a natural construction of such a cut and project scheme, namely, cut and project schemes in relation to cocompact Fuchsian groups acting on the Poincaré disc model of hyperbolic space.
